title: Hearty Peruvian Spaghetti Grill
description: A satvic-friendly grilled chicken dish topped with spaghetti, fresh spinach, and savory bonito flakes for a crowd-pleasing lunch.
instructions: Marinate the chicken thighs with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, chili flakes, salt, and pepper for 10 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Sauté the spinach in a small pan with a splash of olive oil until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Divide the cooked spaghetti into bowls, top with the sautéed spinach.
Slice the grilled chicken and arrange it over the spaghetti.
Sprinkle bonito flakes over the chicken and drizzle with fresh lime juice.
Serve immediately with a side of lime wedges if desired.
